messages.subject: Resize tabsetPanel on basicPage
parts:
Hello all!

I am using a tabsetPanel on a basicPage to display some visualizations.  With in each tab my visuals are getting cutoff, you can not see all of the image.  There is a slider bar to scroll over and see the rest of the image but that is too clunky for what I am going for.

How can I re-size the tabsetPanel or mainPanel to be larger?  I can not find any documentation to do this.

Thanks!

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: Resize tabsetPanel on basicPage
parts:
There are ways to resize part of the standard layout..

but it sounds like you might want to add some height and width indicators to your renderPlot call (see below).

output$plots <- renderPlot({

...

}, width=700, height=700)

You can also put this in a css file (e.g., style.css) in your www directory

.well { 
  padding: 12px; 
  margin-bottom: 5px; 
  max-width: 280px; 
}

.span4 { 
  max-width: 280px; 
}

and call it in ui.R using

      tags$head(
        tags$link(rel="stylesheet", type="text/css", href="style.css")
      ),
